data.long_meaning: The name Garwin is derived from the Germanic elements gar meaning spear and win meaning friend. This name was popular during the Middle Ages and was given to a boy who was considered a brave and loyal companion. The name Garwin carries the meaning “Spear-friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Garwin usually hope their child will grow to embody spear-friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
